query: I have an 88-year-old male ICU patient. Among male ICU patients aged 83–93, what percentile is a per-stay average MAP of 60 mmHg during the first 48 hours (≥3 measurements)?
final_sql:
WITH PatientAge AS (
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    anchor_age
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients`
  WHERE
    gender = 'M' AND anchor_age BETWEEN 83 AND 93
),
ICUStays AS (
  SELECT
    icustays.subject_id,
    icustays.hadm_id,
    icustays.stay_id,
    icustays.intime,
    icustays.outtime
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays`
  INNER JOIN
    PatientAge ON icustays.subject_id = PatientAge.subject_id
),
MAPMeasurements AS (
  SELECT
    icustays.subject_id,
    icustays.hadm_id,
    icustays.stay_id,
    icustays.intime,
    icustays.outtime,
    chartevents.charttime,
    chartevents.valuenum AS map_value
  FROM
    ICUStays
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` AS chartevents
    ON icustays.subject_id = chartevents.subject_id
    AND icustays.hadm_id = chartevents.hadm_id
    AND icustays.stay_id = chartevents.stay_id
  WHERE
    chartevents.itemid = 455 -- MAP itemid
    AND chartevents.charttime BETWEEN icustays.intime AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(icustays.intime, INTERVAL 48 HOUR)
),
PerStayAverageMAP AS (
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    stay_id,
    AVG(map_value) AS avg_map
  FROM
    MAPMeasurements
  GROUP BY
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    stay_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(map_value) >= 3
)
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(avg_map, 0.5) AS median_avg_map
FROM
  PerStayAverageMAP;
